description: Generate a seamless tileable pixel art texture. Produces a square texture that tiles seamlessly in all directions — ideal for terrain, floors, walls, and backgrounds. No background removal is applied; the texture fills the entire canvas.

description.description: What the texture is (e.g. "grass terrain", "stone brick wall", "wooden floor planks", "water surface")

model.description: Model alias or full ID. Aliases: 25, nano-banana, banana, banana-2, nano-banana-2, gemini-flash, flash, gemini-pro, pro, gemini-25, gemini-flash-25 (default: nano-banana)

size.description: Target texture size in pixels (default: 32). Snaps to nearest standard size. Common: 16 for retro, 32 for standard, 64 for detailed.

name: forge_tileset
